title: Discovery of novel TACE inhibitors using graph convolutional network, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and Biological evaluation.
summary: TACE-trained predictions selected vorinostat, followed by cellular biological evaluation; the evidence does not independently establish selective direct target inhibition or treatment benefit.
organization: Kangwon National University; Nationwide Children's Hospital
